_note: Printer used by tools/plates.py. Profiles are Bambu Studio system presets (names as in the Bambu Studio GUI). printable = [x0, y0, x1, y1] the area BOTH nozzles reach (X2D: right nozzle starts at x 20.5, from the machine profile's extruder_printable_area). Change here when the printer, plate or filament changes. gap = mm between parts; brim_room = extra mm around tall, slender parts (height > 2 x smallest footprint side), which get a brim: with gap 4 a 5 mm brim still clears its neighbour by 2 mm.
